title: Two-vehicle crash blocks southbound Bob Bullock Loop; one person hospitalized
excerpt: A crash involving a pickup truck and a sedan blocked the southbound lanes of Bob Bullock Loop in the 2800 block near U.S. Highway 59 on Tuesday afternoon. One person was taken to a hospital with non-life-threatening injuries, according to KGNS.
content:
A crash on Tuesday, November 10, at about 12:50 p.m. blocked the southbound lanes of Bob Bullock Loop in the 2800 block, near U.S. Highway 59 in Laredo, according to KGNS.

Two vehicles were involved, a pickup truck and a sedan. Laredo police and fire responded to the scene.

One person was transported to a hospital with non-life-threatening injuries, according to KGNS.

At the time of the report, there was no information on the cause of the crash or whether any citations were issued. KGNS said it had reached out to the Laredo Police Department for more information.

Sources: KGNS, November 10, 2026.
